facts.business: KIOCL Limited is a Government of India enterprise engaged in the manufacture and sale of iron oxide pellets for domestic and export markets, conversion and tolling services for other producers, and geoscientific services as a Notified Exploration Agency.

auditor.name: G BALU ASSOCIATES LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: 1. Kudremukh Mining Operations suspended since 2006 Supreme Court order; assets disposed/transferred, buildings reduced to NIL value, Lakhya dam shown under PPE as main water source. 2. Blast Furnace Unit (BFU) not in operation since 2009; no impairment recognized as recoverable amount exceeds carrying amount. Capital work in progress for BFU forward/backward integration projects not concluded; management asserts no impairment. 3. Right to Use (ROU) Asset - Land allotted by KIADB at Mangalore (2008) and Doddaballapura (2016); construction of railway siding and R&D centre not started within stipulated time.

key_risks: Kudremukh mine closure and land disputes
BFU non-operation since 2009 and impairment risk
Delays in Devadari Iron Ore Mine forest land handover and clearances
Non-compliance with SEBI LODR requirements (Board composition, committees, woman independent director)
Cyber security audit final report awaited
